snippet.title: THE FUNSKIN PROJECT | Midsummer Night's Scream: A HORROR GAME AWARDS SHOWCASE 2026
snippet.description:
Now that a snowstorm has devastated the region, the only way to continue your journey is through the castle of the mysterious Baron Fetuccini. Arriving at the castle, you discover a nightmare from which it seems impossible to escape. Explore varied labyrinthine environments in a non-linear way, solve puzzles and riddles, and carefully manage your resources in this survival horror game where the slightest encounter can be fatal. Meet other characters who are also trapped in the castle. Assisting them may help you unlock the secrets behind the mysterious Funskin Project.
---
Originally aired during MIDSUMMER NIGHT'S SCREAM: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Monday 1 June 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
